description: This file defines the TraceLoggingCommon class, which provides static methods for logging diagnostic events at different levels, and a method to check if trace logging is enabled. It also declares private members related to logging channels and activities, and a session GUID.

classes.name: TraceLoggingCommon
classes.description: A sealed ref class providing static methods for logging diagnostic events and managing trace logging state.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of TraceLoggingCommon.

methods.name: LogLevel1Event
methods.description: Logs an event at level 1 with specified event name and fields.

methods.name: LogLevel2Event
methods.description: Logs an event at level 2 with specified event name and fields.

methods.name: LogLevel3Event
methods.description: Logs an event at level 3 with specified event name and fields.

methods.name: GetTraceLoggingProviderEnabled
methods.description: Checks if trace logging provider is enabled.
